title: “Mihail POLCANOV 2025” Memorial Tournament: registration for the first stage
body_html:
Registration for the first stage of the “Mihail N. POLCANOV” Table Tennis Memorial Tournament – 2025 edition has closed, with applications from 84 players.

The tournament organisers are delighted with the interest shown and the large number of entries!

As a reminder, the event will take place on Saturday, 10 May 2025, at the TOP CUP Academy arena in Chișinău, according to the previously published schedule and tournament Regulations.
